sourcedFrom: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 (ABSENT — no copyright year line is printed.)
cleanIntro: The TTX30 is a one-piece titanium rifle can, 3D printed with its baffles as part of the body. It screws straight onto a 5/8x24 muzzle and nothing on it comes apart. Taurus prints one page of care: the outside, threads and shoulder with a cloth and nylon brush, and the inside by soaking the closed can. Everything about your rifle comes from that rifle's own manual.

steps.title: Host unloaded, magazine out, action open
steps.action: Point the muzzle somewhere safe, take the magazine out, open the action and look: the chamber must be empty. Leave the action open while the can is being handled. If you are not sure how your firearm clears, use its own manual.
steps.prose: Your hand is about to be at the muzzle. Taurus will not have this can put on over a closed action, and an open one shows you the chamber the whole time.
steps.quote: Verify the chamber is empty and the magazine is removed before proceeding.
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Installation, WARNING, printed p.9
steps.warn: Do not install the suppressor on a firearm with a closed action.

steps.title: Let it cool all the way
steps.action: Wait until the can is fully cool before you take hold of it. If it has to come off sooner, wear heat-resistant gloves, and set it down on something that cannot burn. It does not go into a case until it is cold.
steps.prose: A string of .308 puts a lot of heat into this can, it stays hot for several minutes after the last shot, and the body is the only part there is to grip.
steps.aside: Do not place it on flammable surfaces or store it in a case until fully cooled.
steps.quote: The suppressor becomes hot during use. Allow it to cool fully before handling, transporting, or storing. If immediate handling is necessary, use heat-resistant gloves.
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Suppressor Safety, WARNING, printed p.5

steps.title: Know what it is rated for
steps.action: Check what has been going through it. The manual lists .308 Win, 7.62x51 NATO, 300 Blackout, 6.5 Creedmoor and 243 Win, and nothing else.
steps.prose: Plenty of rifles share a 5/8x24 muzzle. The threads fitting does not make the cartridge safe in this can.
steps.quote: Our suppressors are caliber specific. This 30 Caliber suppressor is rated for cartridges listed in the specification on page 6.
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Installation, DANGER, printed p.9; Specifications, printed p.6
steps.warn: Use outside of these specifications could result in bodily injury, death and property damage.

steps.title: Unscrew it: turn the body counter-clockwise
steps.action: Grip the body and turn it counter-clockwise by hand until it comes off the muzzle threads. Keep it straight as the last threads let go so it does not drag across them.
steps.prose: It is a direct-thread can: no latch, no collar, no mount to release. Taurus gives no tool for taking it off.
steps.quote: To remove, rotate the body counter-clockwise until it unthreads from the muzzle.
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Removing the Suppressor, printed p.11

steps.title: ⛔ That is the whole strip: it does not come apart
steps.action: Stop here. The body and the baffles inside it are printed as one solid piece, so there is no end cap, mount or baffle to take out. Nothing on this can unscrews but the can itself.
steps.prose: Altering it in any way ends the warranty, and Taurus calls it dangerous.
steps.quote: The suppressor body and internal baffle stack are produced as a single, seamless monolithic unit. There are no separate baffle discs, end caps, or threaded internal components.
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Monolithically 3D Printed Construction, printed p.7
steps.warn: Do not modify this suppressor in any way. Modification voids the warranty and is dangerous.

steps.title: Outside, threads and mount shoulder
steps.action: Use a cloth dampened with solvent on the outside of the can. Take a nylon brush to its threads and to the mount shoulder, the face that seats against the barrel.
steps.prose: The shoulder is what sets the can straight on the barrel. Carbon left on it can tilt the can, and a tilted can is how a baffle gets hit.
steps.quote: Clean external surfaces, threads, and mount shoulder regularly with a solvent-dampened cloth and nylon brush.
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Cleaning and Maintenance, printed p.12
steps.warn: Always read the warning label on any solvent before use. Most cleaning solvents are toxic and/or flammable. Wear appropriate skin and eye protection and work in a well-ventilated area.

steps.title: Inside: submerge it and soak
steps.action: To clean the inside, put the whole can under in a commercial cleaning solution. Leave it for the time that solution's own maker gives.
steps.prose: Taurus prints no soak time of its own. Read the label before the can goes in and make sure the solution suits titanium and a Cerakote finish.
steps.quote: To clean internally, submerge the suppressor in a commercial cleaning solution and soak for the time specified by the manufacturer.
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Cleaning and Maintenance, printed p.12

steps.title: Rinse with clean water, dry it completely
steps.action: Rinse the can out thoroughly with clean water. Then let it dry all the way through before it goes back on a gun.
steps.prose: You cannot see behind the baffles, so give it longer than the outside looks like it needs. Liquid left in there is in the bullet's way.
steps.quote: Rinse thoroughly with clean water and allow to dry completely before reinstalling.
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Cleaning and Maintenance, printed p.12

steps.title: A light coat of oil outside, for storage
steps.action: Before it is put away, wipe a light coat of oil over all the outside metal.
steps.prose: A thin film is enough. The oil is for the outside only; Taurus puts none inside the can.
steps.quote: Apply a light coat of oil to all external metal surfaces before storage.
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Cleaning and Maintenance, printed p.12

steps.title: Look it over, and look through it
steps.action: Check the body for a crack or a dent and the exit hole for a fresh bright mark or a torn edge. Hold it to the light and look through the bore: one clean round hole, nothing in it. Taurus wants this before every use, not only at cleaning.
steps.prose: A bullet touching the inside is a baffle strike. Any one of these signs means the can does not go back on the gun.
steps.quote: Inspect the suppressor before every use. Do not use if the suppressor is cracked, dented, loose, or shows signs of baffle strike damage. Inspect the bore for obstructions before firing.
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Suppressor Safety, WARNING, printed p.5

steps.title: If it needs service: an RMA from Taurus first
steps.action: A damaged can goes to Taurus, and only after you have a return authorization from them. Phone 229-235-4020 or 800-327-3776, or write to the support address in the manual. They send the number and tell you where it ships.
steps.prose: There is no owner repair for a one-piece can.
steps.quote: DO NOT RETURN YOUR SUPPRESSOR WITHOUT FIRST OBTAINING AN RMA (RETURN MATERIAL AUTHORIZATION).
steps.cite: TTX 30 30 CALIBER SUPPRESSOR INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ABSENT — no revision or date code is printed; part number 045-0061-01 — Taurus Limited Lifetime Warranty, printed p.15

deepAbsentReason: Taurus's book has nothing deeper than the clean above. It says of the TTX30 'Monocore design. No disassembly required.' (printed p.2), and that the body and baffle stack are a single, seamless monolithic unit with sealed construction and no separate baffle discs, end caps, or threaded internal components (printed p.7). The only inside cleaning it prints is a soak with the can whole, a rinse and a full dry (printed p.12), and that is part of the regular clean. A can that needs more goes to Taurus, with a return authorization first (printed p.15).

cleaning.name: OUTSIDE, THREADS AND SHOULDER
tasks: Outside wiped with a solvent-dampened cloth
Threads and mount shoulder: nylon brush and the dampened cloth
Solvent label read; skin and eyes covered; moving air

cleaning.name: INSIDE: A SOAK, NEVER APART
tasks: Whole can submerged in a commercial cleaning solution
Left for the time on that solution's own label
Dried completely before it goes back on
⛔ Nothing on the can is opened or unscrewed

cleaning.name: BEFORE STORAGE
tasks: Light coat of oil on the outside metal
Fully cool before it goes in a case

reassembly: Host still unloaded, magazine out, action open. ⛔ Do not put the can on over a closed action.
Barrel threads clean and free of debris. Oil them lightly, then wipe them with a lint-free cloth. The can must be dry all the way through.
Line the can up with the barrel and thread it on by hand without cross-threading. It should turn smoothly. ⛔ If you feel resistance, stop and take it to a qualified gunsmith.
Keep turning until it bottoms out squarely on the barrel shoulder, then tighten it firmly by hand only. ⛔ No tools.
Check it is in line with the bore with a suppressor alignment rod before you fire it. ⛔ A can that is out of line does not get fired.
fncheck: Host still unloaded, action open: the can is bottomed square on the barrel shoulder, hand tight, and the alignment rod runs through it in line with the bore with nothing in the way. Direct-thread cans loosen as you shoot, so check it and snug it again regularly, with heat-resistant gloves on. The first shot may be louder than the rest; Taurus calls that first-round pop and it is normal.
